title: Key Lean floor atoms by their argument's normal form
summary: The Lean reconstructor now keys a floor (to_int) by its argument's normal form, so floors of a nested Real ite chain and of the rewriter's copy get their own congruence equality, and a depth-8 QF_UFLIRA floor chain that used to exhaust heartbeats now checks in Lean. Keys are also cached and interned, so keying deep chains takes linear time.
